digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store mounting
propositions: rebar init currently creates empty orphan branches when ticket fetch fails or times out, even if the remote branch exists

A bounded remote-advertisement probe using git ls-remote with tri-state result (advertised, reachable-absent, unreachable) must be cached and shared across _mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, and _create_tracker
Unreachable remotes must fail closed with actionable diagnostics and never auto-create orphan branches unless --force-new-store is explicitly supplied
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount without error, reusing the cached probe result for the following strict init path
Advertisement probe timeout and other network failures must be caught and converted to return code 124, distinct from reachable-absent (code 2)
Cold fetch retains its 300-second bound while advertisement probe uses a shorter named timeout; TTL cache of tri-state results limits probes to at most one per CLI invocation
